statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 2∣n → 15 ≤ ((Finset.range 210).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 210 ∧ Nat.Coprime ((n+210-r)%210) 210)).card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · S01 · 核对每个偶数至少有 15 个允许的模 210 反射类
plain_statement.en: New route · S01 · Verify at least 15 allowed reflected classes modulo 210 for every even target
